synopsis: NI is identified as a supplier of real-time computing hardware alongside dSPACE and Speedgoat [f16180]. The middle-cost example chain offers Speedgoat or NI for later hardware-in-the-loop testing, combined with an externally validated sensor model packaged as an OSI-compatible FMU and cloud GPUs for batch runs [f9288, f16163]. The highest-cost example chain includes dSPACE or NI HIL benches alongside heavy-machine dynamics, specialist sensor simulation and cloud execution [f9306, f16167]. NI's HIL deployment cases report large productivity gains, but these vendor case studies are not controlled cross-vendor measurements and therefore do not establish comparative superiority [f8736].

relations.note: Both identify Speedgoat or NI for later HIL testing in the middle-cost chain.
Both identify dSPACE or NI HIL benches in the highest-cost chain.
NI's real-time hardware classification supports its proposed role in later HIL testing.
Real-time hardware classification supports dSPACE and NI's proposed HIL bench role.
